description: Create customizable contact, inquiry, feedback and registration forms in your connected FormBuilder account. Save a private draft or explicitly request publication to get a live link. List forms and response counts, inspect supported fields, and summarize available responses. Sensitive-data workflows are unavailable through this plugin. Attachments and restricted-looking response values are omitted from ChatGPT results. Sign in through the FormBuilder connection flow. Editing existing forms, webhooks, deletion, payments and conditional logic are not supported by this plugin.

defaultPrompt: Draft a feedback form with a rating and optional comments.
List my forms and tell me which have the most responses.
Summarize the latest 5 responses to my Customer Feedback Survey.
